articles.title: 1988년 당시 보도: 대처 총리, 축구 관중 신분증 계획에 물러서지 않다

events.title: Uruguayan Danny Bergara , 46, becomes the first foreign manager in English football when he takes over at Fourth Division club 로치데일 .
After three years in Italy with Bari , former 애스턴 빌라 striker Paul Rideout returns to England in a £430,000 move to 사우샘프턴 .
토트넘 홋스퍼 complete a British transfer record £2 million deal for 21-year-old 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 midfielder Paul Gascoigne . Gascoigne signs a contract at White Hart Lane until the end of the 1992–93 season .
Italian club 유벤투스 receive The UEFA Plaque in Geneva (Switzerland) as first club in European football history to win the three main UEFA club competitions .
The long hunt for a new Wales national football team manager ends when 스완지 시티 manager Terry Yorath is appointed on a part-time basis.
Gordon Cowans ends his three-year spell at Bari to rejoin 애스턴 빌라 in a £250,000 deal, while 에버턴 strengthen their midfield in a £925,000 move for 첼시 and Scotland midfielder Pat Nevin .

England defender Gary Stevens moves to Scotland in a £1 million move from 에버턴 to 레인저스 in the costliest transfer involving a British defender. He is replaced at Goodison Park by 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's Neil McDonald .
After two poor seasons at 바르셀로나 , Mark Hughes returns to 맨체스터 유나이티드 for a club record £1.8 million, breaking the previous record of £1.75 million that the club paid for Bryan Robson seven years ago.
Less than three weeks after 토트넘 홋스퍼 broke the national transfer record, a new record is set when 에버턴 complete the signing of 웨스트햄 유나이티드 's 23-year-old striker Tony Cottee for £2.2 million.
Billy Bonds , the oldest player in the Football League at 41, announces his retirement as a player but will remain with 웨스트햄 유나이티드 as youth team coach.
